purpose: Independently placeable square tile art for Yangzhou; do not use the starter panorama as the gameplay board
art_status: prototype-composite; topology validated, not visually approved
artist_requirements: Author each topology as its own complete clean square; do not slice a multi-tile panorama
Use identical centred road and water openings with stable paving/bank detail 30px into each edge
Keep architecture upright under logical 90-degree rotation; author compass variants for lighting-sensitive tiles
Keep people, boats, steam, wakes and other moving objects out of the base; supply independent transparent layers
Bridge roads and waterways remain distinct route networks separated by height
After replacing shared-source composites, inspect all starter internal joins and rotated perimeter matches
Obtain cultural and architectural review before historical-authenticity claims
known_gaps: Some starter masters recompose elements from the same two source paintings; duplicated architecture is visible
Shared boundary pixels and legal edge labels do not guarantee natural banks or uninterrupted cobbled routes 20-100 units inside the tile
Five-Pavilion foreground is a transitional extracted cut-out and needs a bespoke overhead version
The source clean plate and its foreground masks were built for the earlier panorama and are not per-tile production masks
